# std/shr

> >> : arithmetic shift right (keeps the sign)

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/shr.pkg) · translated by [bintables/shr](../bintables/shr.md) · translated by [ctables/shr](../ctables/shr.md)

```
print -16 >> 2   // -4
```

Infix, precedence 60, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`;
the result is `int`. Shift counts use the low 6 bits.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 60, left-associative

```
{left: expr int} >> {right: expr int} -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `left` | expression | `int` |
| `right` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
